limitations: No screenshots, browser QA, frontend tests, or live visual measurement; prohibited unless explicitly requested.
Scoped source-review findings were scored resolved: four home findings, four Connections findings, and two mobile-preview findings; this is not whole-surface runtime or rendered approval.
Snippets require inherited runtime theme and typography variables; they are isolated style samples without application behavior.
Tonal ramps are derived panel-only previews of active variables, not observed application palette tokens or new design rules.

resolved: Bounded local-desktop 401 recovery and clearing its bearer cache on logout
Non-announcing countdown with readable static expiry
Focus continuation after approval and simulated pairing
44px coarse-pointer filters, disclosures, and send control

capabilityBoundary.connections: Uses inherited Synara pairing/auth/device APIs with a T3-derived secure pairing-URL helper. The opt-in CLI tunnel service requires manually configured Cloudflare resources. It defaults to existing desktop data; Electron must quit before switching. Paired desktop browsers and phones share one service.
capabilityBoundary.mobilePreview: Local simulated state only; no network, real credentials, or Agent execution. Downloaded files contain demo text.
notDelivered: Full Electron attachment to the persistent service; automatic merge of the historical isolated remote database

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared Button default size; label is an illustrative static preview.
components.css: .ds-button{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-ui-family);font-size:var(--app-font-size-ui);font-weight:500;height:36px;padding:0 11px;outline:none;transition:background-color 200ms ease-out,border-color 200ms ease-out,color 200ms ease-out,opacity 200ms ease-out,transform 200ms ease-out}.ds-button:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--background),0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring) 60%,transparent)}.ds-button:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.64}@media(min-width:40rem){.ds-button{height:32px}}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-button::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;min-width:44px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none;transform:none}}.ds-primary{background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-foreground)}.ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary[data-pressed]{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary) 90%,transparent)}

components.name: Text input
components.description: Shared Input default wrapper and field; runtime theme and typography variables are inherited.
components.css: .ds-input-control{display:inline-flex;width:100%;min-height:36px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;border-radius:inherit;background:transparent;padding:6px 12px;font-family:var(--font-ui-family);font-size:var(--app-font-size-ui);line-height:1.5;outline:none}.ds-input::placeholder{color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--muted-foreground) 72%,transparent)}.ds-input-control:has(:focus-visible){border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--foreground) 30%,transparent)}.ds-input-control:has([aria-invalid=true]){border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 30%,transparent)}.ds-input-control:has([aria-invalid=true]:focus-visible){border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input-control:has(:disabled){opacity:.64}@media(min-width:40rem){.ds-input-control{min-height:32px}}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input-control{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--input) 32%,transparent)}

narrative.overview: Metis extends Synara's existing desktop workspace. Preserve its compact controls, theme-aware surfaces, shared icon geometry, and user-scaled typography. The user selected Metis as the product name. The user selected the Folded Volume cube in Blue as the current logo on 2026-09-23. Use the original PNG through the shared branding primitive; keep the existing UI tokens and primary-button palette. See docs/workbench/branding.md for assets and native integration scope.
keyCharacteristics: Dense application chrome with a readable, row-based work overview.
Neutral surfaces and restrained state feedback; provider identity and status carry functional color.
Shared primitives and server-backed project, thread, and provider information.

rules.name: The Theme Binding Rule
rules.body: Keep color roles live-bound to the inherited theme; the fallback palette is not a second brand specification.

rules.name: The User Scale Rule
rules.body: Ordinary interface text follows Settings. The home page's large heading is an explicit heading exception, not permission to give labels or controls fixed sizes.

dos: Do reuse shared components, existing icons, theme roles, and Settings-driven text sizes.
Do retain distinct loading, unavailable, disabled, approval, and retry states from actual application data.
Do preserve focus feedback, coarse-pointer affordances, and the shared button's reduced-motion behavior.
Do label simulated tasks, devices, connections, and files as examples on preview surfaces.
donts: Don't substitute a new primary palette or decorative provider/status colors.
Don't turn the home page's column arrangement or large heading into a rule for every application screen.
Don't claim rendered contrast, responsive fit, or live provider success from this source-only record.
Don't equate a generated pairing link or remote-URL field with a deployed cloud service, working tunnel, QR flow, or native phone app.
